free_tier.stated: Eight storage plans, all one vCPU, priced in euro with a promotional rate and a renewal rate printed side by side: 256 GB for EUR 1.78/month (renews EUR 4.45), 512 GB EUR 2.17 (EUR 5.42), 1 TB EUR 3.34 (EUR 8.35), 2 TB EUR 5.29 (EUR 13.22), 3 TB EUR 9.66 (EUR 24.14), 4 TB EUR 17.85 (EUR 44.62), 6 TB EUR 27.00 (EUR 67.49) and 8 TB EUR 54.00 (EUR 134.99). RAM runs 0.5 GB to 16 GB and transfer 2 TB to 64 TB with the plan.
